*Coming soon.* Not an embedding model in sight — just raw 62d joint-angle vectors from human motion capture. The ground truth "k" here is soft (movement types overlap), so the metric shifts from NMI-against-labels toward *sim-gap* (inter- vs intra-cluster similarity). Demonstrates DYF working directly on physical signal, no embedding detour.
